name: Base Splat Model Generation
definition: A technique to replace isolated 3D points with elliptical surface patches (splats) that approximate the underlying local surface geometry, using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) on neighbor points to determine orientation and scale.
summary: Base Splat Model Generation replaces isolated 3D points with elliptical surface patches derived from local neighbor statistics via PCA, distinguishing itself from convex splatting and compositional merging strategies.
